result.stdout:
Description:
  AdoMCP Server — MCP server for database schema discovery and SQL execution.

Usage:
  adomcp [options] [[--] <additional arguments>...]]

Options:
  --http           Start in HTTP/SSE mode instead of the default stdio mode.
  --stdio          Start in stdio mode (default; accepted for compatibility).
  --allow-any-sql  Set the default write policy for dynamic connections and static connections without an override. Omit to use AllowAnySql from configuration (default false).
  -?, -h, --help   Show help and usage information
  --version        Show version information

Additional Arguments:
  Arguments passed to the application that is being run.
